facts.fact: The criterion is cultivable land owned by the farmer family as per the land records of the State/UT
facts.quote: minor children who own cultivable land as per the land records of the concerned State/UT

facts.fact: Someone cultivating land that is in the father's name is not covered: the land must be in his or her own name
facts.quote: No. The land must be in his / her own name. lf the land ownership has been transferred in his / her name on account of succession then he / she will be eligible.

summary: PM-KISAN's own Revised FAQ (Q16, Q17) states the own-name land-records criterion, so the citation need not be the PM-KMY FAQ; confirmed.
